source.author: verg
source.text: Limus ut hic durescit et haec ut cera liquescit uno eodemque igni, sic nostro Daphnis amore.
source.text_original: Limus ut hic durescit et haec ut cera liquescit / uno eodemque igni, sic nostro Daphnis amore.
source.text_english: As this clay hardens and as this wax melts in the same fire, so does Daphnis by our love.

reuse.author: hier
reuse.text: alioquin unus est solis calor et secundum essentias subiacentes alia liquefacit, alia indurat, alia soluit, alia constringit; liquatur enim cera et induratur lutum et tamen non est caloris diuersa natura.
reuse.text_original: alioquin unus est solis calor et secundum essentias subiacentes alia liquefacit, alia indurat, alia soluit, alia constringit; liquatur enim cera et induratur lutum et tamen non est caloris diuersa natura.
reuse.text_english: Otherwise the sun’s heat is one and the same, and according to the underlying substances it liquefies some things, hardens others, dissolves others, and constricts others; for wax is melted and clay is hardened, and yet the nature of the heat is not different.
